input.text: Huge Performance Boost Feature Coming
Soon to Windows 11
Leave a Comment / By emanueldas / September 3, 2026
In this article, we will talk about the New Unified Memory Controls that
Microsoft is testing behind the scenes, which can improve the system
performance in certain scenarios.
First of all, we need to mention that not all Windows 11 Devices will have
this Features. This is a Specific Feature to New Hardware from Nvidia or
AMD that supports the Unified Memory Technology.
In the latest Build from the Experimental Channel Future Platforms,
Microsoft has hidden inside the System the New Settings Section where
you can customize how Unified Memory is used inside Windows 11.
Unified Memory is a different type of memory that can be shared between
a CPU, GPU, and other components. With this New Option, you can
customize how that Memory is shared between components.
